summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for a scheduled bronchoscopy with balloon dilation due to recurrent tracheobronchial stenosis from relapsing polychondritis and SMAD4 syndrome. Post-procedure, he reported left-sided chest pain consistent with prior experiences, which resolved without intervention. He remained stable throughout the admission, with no respiratory distress or signs of infection. His white blood cell count was elevated but attributed to chronic inflammation and steroid use. The chest X-ray showed stable cardiomegaly and clear lungs. He was discharged home the following morning in stable condition with instructions to follow up with interventional pulmonology and primary care, continuing his baseline medications including methotrexate and prednisone.
